description: Brushless cordless hammer drill with REDLINK PLUS intelligence and an all-metal ratcheting chuck. Delivers 1200 in-lbs of torque for masonry and heavy timber.
Compact brushless drill driver with a two-speed transmission and an LED work light. Weighs 3.4 lbs for reduced fatigue during overhead work.
Cordless circular saw with an electric brake and a built-in dust blower. Cuts 2x material at 90 degrees in a single pass.
Brushless reciprocating saw with adjustable orbital action and a tool-free blade change. Rated for demolition and nail-embedded wood.
Tape measure with a 13 ft standout and a BladeArmor coating on the first 3 inches to resist tearing. Includes a magnetic hook.
Forged one-piece steel hammer with a shock-reduction grip. Fully polished face and a straight rip claw for prying.
Paint and primer in one with a low-VOC formula. Covers up to 400 sq ft per gallon and resists mildew in bathrooms and kitchens.
Angular sash brush with a Nylox blend for use with all paints. Holds a sharp edge for cutting in along trim and ceilings.
Galvanized joist hanger for 2x8 dimensional lumber. Load rated for residential floor and deck framing when installed with 10d nails.
Structural screw with a W-Cut thread and a CEE thread for self-countersinking. Climatek coated for exterior use without pre-drilling.
